activities.label: Temples & shrines
activities.description: Religious and historical sites, etiquette-led visits, gardens, and festival context.

activities.label: Food crawls
activities.description: Ramen, sushi, depachika, izakaya alleys, markets, cafes, and specialty dining.

activities.label: Museums & galleries
activities.description: Major museums, small specialist collections, contemporary galleries, and immersive art.

activities.label: Shopping & design
activities.description: Department stores, stationery, vintage, craft, fashion, knives, and concept stores.

activities.label: Nightlife & bars
activities.description: Izakaya, listening bars, cocktail counters, clubs, LGBTQ+ nightlife, and late-night districts.

activities.label: Onsen & wellness
activities.description: Hot springs, sento, head spas, massage, bathing etiquette, and recovery days.

activities.label: City walks
activities.description: Neighborhood wandering, architecture, parks, side streets, rivers, and station-to-station walks.

activities.label: Day trips
activities.description: Short rail trips to nearby heritage towns, mountain areas, seaside cities, and onsen regions.
